text: I brought myself and my family (all three of us) to get clear aligners from Dr. Por. Dr. Por provides excellent care and is very meticulous in her work. The clinic is clean and private. The staff manages the appointments efficiently, so there's almost no waiting time. My orthodontic treatment is complete now, but I will continue to be a regular customer for check-ups. ⭐️⭐️⭐️👍

I've been a patient of Dr. Phung for many years. I still come here for checkups and dental work. I like that the doctor takes the time to explain things clearly before each procedure and has a very gentle touch. 👍🏻
The clinic is very clean, the appointment system is efficient and on time, and there's convenient parking. 👍🏻👍🏻

The doctor has a very gentle hand. I've been coming here for five years to have my teeth scaled. He takes good care of me and gives good advice. The place is very clean and has parking. Very convenient.

I've been getting my dental work done by Dr. Por for over 10 years and I have no intention of changing dentists. Even though my house is far away, I'm willing to travel there because she's very gentle and attentive to her patients.
Dr. Por is so gentle and takes great care of her patients. She's always so kind and friendly during her shifts. I barely feel any pain; I almost fall asleep in her arms! 😆 …
The doctor is always meticulous and attentive, consistently so every time I visit. The treatment is painless, and the doctor explains everything very well. I highly recommend him/her! ♥️
